_comment: ORACLE DATASET for ship 012 chat-export-redactor. Authored by the ARCHITECT on 2026-08-11 BEFORE any artifact code existed (v4: NO ORACLE, NO BUILD). Every field below fixes the target set the builder codes to; the builder may not edit this file, and the checker drives the staged page against THIS, never against builder-authored cases.

page_contract._comment: The DOM/JS surface the oracle drives. Fixed before the build so the oracle is not shaped around whatever the builder happened to produce.

predicates.P1_client_side: While a fixture is processed, ZERO network requests leave the page other than to the page's own origin beacon path (/_b, /_b/*) or cloudflareinsights. Measured by Chromium request interception. The whole product claim is 'the file never leaves your machine'; if this predicate is not measured the ship is a lie regardless of how well it redacts.
predicates.P2_zero_residual: For every string in the fixture's `identifiers`, 0 case-insensitive occurrences in the DOWNLOADED sanitised file. Name components are listed separately on purpose: a redactor that replaces 'Alice Mokoena' but leaves a bare 'Alice' in a message body has not redacted anything that matters.
predicates.P3_bijection: The downloaded mapping is injective (no two originals share a pseudonym) and total over the participant set; len(distinct pseudonyms) == fixture.participants for chat participants.
predicates.P4_structure: Output line count == input line count, and every string in `timestamps_verbatim` appears in the output, in the same relative order as the input.
predicates.P5_determinism: Two independent browser contexts processing the same fixture produce byte-identical sanitised output.
predicates.P6_non_destruction: Every token in `must_survive` still appears in the output. A redactor that blanks the file passes P2 trivially and is useless.
predicates.P7_telegram_valid: For the telegram fixture the sanitised output parses as JSON and has `json_message_count` messages, and every `from` value is a pseudonym.
predicates.P8_no_map_leak: The sanitised download contains no pseudonym->original mapping; the mapping is a separate download only.
predicates.P9_xss_inert: After processing wa-xss.txt, window.__pwned and window.__pwned2 are undefined in the real browser, and the preview element contains the payload as TEXT. Liveness claim -> executed in Chromium, never asserted from a markup parse (BOTTLENECKS #1 clause 3).
predicates.P10_bad_input: notachat.bin drives the status element to the ERROR token and NO sanitised download is offered. Silently emitting a 'done' state over an unparsed file is the failure mode that gets somebody doxxed.

probe_contract._comment: PROBE-THE-ORACLE (v4, promoted from BOTTLENECKS #1's own analysis). An oracle is trusted only after both halves pass.
probe_contract.negative_controls: probe.py wraps window.ChatRedact.redact in the live page with a deliberately broken implementation, one per predicate, and asserts the oracle goes RED. A control the oracle does not catch is a FAIL finding against the oracle, not against the artifact.
probe_contract.independent_break: A documented attempt to construct an artifact that passes every predicate and is still wrong. Result recorded in probe.py's header whether or not it succeeded.
